tools.name: create_lead
tools.description: Create a Pool Pro Florida service lead in Pool Founder when a customer is interested in service but is not yet booking an appointment. Do not call this before book_appointment for the same inquiry because a successful Cal.com booking creates the Pool Founder lead through the booking webhook.

service.description: Requested service, such as Pool Cleaning or Pool Consultation.

tools.name: get_available_times
tools.description: Get real Cal.com appointment availability for Pool Pro Florida. Use date-only YYYY-MM-DD values. Use this when a customer wants to schedule a pool consultation or service appointment.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone. Defaults to America/New_York.

tools.name: book_appointment
tools.description: Book a confirmed Pool Pro Florida appointment through Cal.com after the customer has selected an available time. Requires customer name, email, service address, and the exact start value returned by get_available_times. A successful booking triggers the existing Cal.com webhook, which creates the lead in Pool Founder.

phone.description: Customer phone number. Normal U.S. formatting is accepted.

address.description: Pool service address; Cal.com uses this as the attendee address/location.

start.description: Exact ISO 8601 slot start returned by get_available_times.

notes.description: Optional notes about the pool or requested service.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone. Defaults to America/New_York.

tools.name: get_site_map
tools.description: Read the current PoolProFlorida.com sitemap index and discover published site pages. Use this to find the correct Pool Pro Florida page before reading current website content. An optional query ranks likely relevant page URLs first.

query.description: Optional Pool Pro Florida topic, such as weekly service, green pool, service area, pricing, Pool School, or a neighborhood name.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching sitemap URLs to return.

tools.name: read_site_page
tools.description: Read the current text of a PoolProFlorida.com page. The page must be present in the current Pool Pro Florida sitemap index. Use this for current published services, pricing, service areas, hours, policies, and page-specific business information.

url.description: Exact PoolProFlorida.com URL returned by get_site_map. A site-relative path beginning with / is also accepted.

tools.name: upload_media
tools.description: Import an image attached in ChatGPT into the Pool Pro Florida CMS media library. ChatGPT supplies a temporary download URL and file ID through its native file parameter handoff. The server downloads the image directly, validates it, strips embedded metadata by re-encoding to WebP, stores it outside Git, and returns a stable /media/... URL. This tool does not modify any page.

download_url.description: Temporary HTTPS download URL supplied by ChatGPT for the attached file.

file_id.description: ChatGPT file identifier for the attached file.

mime_type.description: Optional MIME type supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Optional original filename supplied by ChatGPT.

filename.description: Optional override filename. If omitted, the filename supplied by ChatGPT is used.

alt.description: Accessible alt text for the image.

tags.description: Optional media tags such as hero, riverview, or generated.

source.description: Whether the image came from image generation or a user upload.

tools.name: upsert_customer_contact
tools.description: Create or update one private Pool Pro Florida CardDAV contact from Pool Founder. Owner-only and non-destructive: this tool never removes any other contacts.

tools.name: upsert_route_stop_event
tools.description: Create or update one private Pool Pro Florida CalDAV VEVENT from a Pool Founder route stop. The identity is jobId plus serviceDate, so planned timing can later be replaced by actual arrival and departure without duplication. Owner-only and non-destructive.

phone.description: Optional structured customer phone number from Pool Founder. Included in event notes for tap-to-call on mobile calendars.

email.description: Optional structured customer email from Pool Founder. Included in event notes for tap-to-email on mobile calendars.

address.description: Service address. Written to LOCATION so mobile calendars can open Maps.

start.description: ISO 8601 start with UTC offset or Z. Planned before service; actual arrival after completion.

end.description: ISO 8601 end with UTC offset or Z. Planned before service; actual departure after completion.

tools.name: sync_route_calendar
tools.description: Synchronize one complete Pool Founder route-date window into the private Pool Pro Florida CalDAV calendar. Each stop is one stable VEVENT. Completed events are historical records and are never removed. Missing non-completed events inside a validated complete window are retained and marked cancelled instead of deleted.

phone.description: Optional structured customer phone number from Pool Founder. Included in event notes for tap-to-call on mobile calendars.

email.description: Optional structured customer email from Pool Founder. Included in event notes for tap-to-email on mobile calendars.

address.description: Service address. Written to LOCATION so mobile calendars can open Maps.

start.description: ISO 8601 start with UTC offset or Z. Planned before service; actual arrival after completion.

end.description: ISO 8601 end with UTC offset or Z. Planned before service; actual departure after completion.

tools.name: sync_customer_contacts
tools.description: Replace the private Pool Pro Florida CardDAV address book from one complete Pool Founder active-customer snapshot. Owner-only. Creates and updates stable vCards and removes stale Pool Founder contacts only after the complete snapshot validates.
